locations.name: Vapi
locations.description: Vapi is a major industrial city in southern Gujarat, known for its large GIDC industrial estate. It lies near the Maharashtra border and serves as a key commercial hub in Valsad district.
key_facts: Major industrial hub with GIDC estate
Known for chemical and textile industries

locations.name: Valsad
locations.description: Valsad is the district headquarters of Valsad district in southern Gujarat. It is known for its mango orchards, chikoo (sapodilla) farms, and beautiful coastline along the Arabian Sea.
key_facts: Famous for Hapus mangoes and chikoo

locations.name: Udvada
locations.description: Udvada is a small but historically significant village in Valsad district. It is home to the Iranshah Atash Behram, the oldest and most sacred fire temple of the Zoroastrian (Parsi) community in India.
key_facts: Home to Iranshah Atash Behram fire temple
Most sacred Parsi pilgrimage site in India

locations.name: Bulsar
locations.description: Bulsar is a village in Valsad district, historically the older name for the Valsad region. It lies in a fertile coastal belt known for fruit cultivation.
key_facts: Older historical name of Valsad region

locations.name: Surat
locations.description: Surat is the second-largest city in Gujarat and one of the fastest-growing cities in India. It is globally renowned as the Diamond City, processing over 90% of the world's rough diamonds. The textile industry is also a major economic driver.
key_facts: One of India's fastest growing cities

locations.name: Bardoli
locations.description: Bardoli is a historic town in Surat district, famous for the Bardoli Satyagraha of 1928 led by Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel. It is considered a significant site in India's freedom movement.
key_facts: Sardar Patel led the peasant movement here

locations.name: Navsari
locations.description: Navsari is the district headquarters of Navsari district and an important city in southern Gujarat. It is historically significant as the ancestral home of the Tata family and has a large Parsi community.
key_facts: Ancestral home of the Tata family
Agricultural market for sugarcane and mangoes

locations.name: Gandevi
locations.description: Gandevi is a town in Navsari district known for its agricultural produce, especially chikoo (sapodilla) and mango cultivation. It has a thriving local market economy.

locations.name: Bharuch
locations.description: Bharuch (also known as Broach) is one of Gujarat's oldest cities, situated on the banks of the Narmada river. It has a major petrochemical industrial complex (GIDC Ankleshwar nearby) and serves as an important river port.
key_facts: Ankleshwar GIDC — major chemical industrial area
Historical Broach mentioned in ancient texts

locations.name: Ankleshwar
locations.description: Ankleshwar is a major industrial city in Bharuch district, home to one of India's largest chemical industrial estates (GIDC). It is a significant contributor to Gujarat's industrial output.
key_facts: One of India's largest GIDC chemical estates
Major pharma and chemical manufacturing hub

locations.name: Ahmedabad
locations.description: Ahmedabad is the largest city of Gujarat and the financial and commercial capital of the state. It is a UNESCO World Heritage City and home to landmark institutions including IIM Ahmedabad and the Sabarmati Ashram.
key_facts: Home to IIM Ahmedabad and Sabarmati Ashram
Major textile, pharma and IT hub

locations.name: Gandhinagar
locations.description: Gandhinagar is the capital city of Gujarat, designed as a planned city on the banks of the Sabarmati river. It houses the state government offices, Gujarat High Court, and the Akshardham temple complex.
key_facts: GIFT City (Global Financial Technology hub) nearby

locations.name: Vadodara
locations.description: Vadodara (Baroda) is the third-largest city in Gujarat, known as the cultural capital of the state. It is home to the Maharaja Sayajirao University and Laxmi Vilas Palace. Major industries include chemicals, petrochemicals, and defense.
key_facts: Laxmi Vilas Palace — largest private residence at time of construction

locations.name: Halol
locations.description: Halol is a town in Panchmahal district known for its automobile manufacturing industry. Suzuki Motorcycle India has a plant near Halol. General Motors India previously operated a plant here.
key_facts: Suzuki and General Motors plant location

locations.name: Rajkot
locations.description: Rajkot is the fourth-largest city in Gujarat and a major commercial and industrial centre. It was the childhood home of Mahatma Gandhi. Known for its engineering industry, watches, and gold jewelry.
key_facts: Major engineering and auto parts hub
One of India's fastest growing cities
Kaba Gandhi No Delo — Gandhi's ancestral home

locations.name: Jamnagar
locations.description: Jamnagar is a city on the coast of Gujarat known for its brass and handicraft industries. It is home to Reliance Industries' Jamnagar Refinery, which is the world's largest oil refinery complex.
key_facts: Home to world's largest oil refinery (Reliance)
Famous for brass parts and handicrafts

locations.name: Bhavnagar
locations.description: Bhavnagar is a coastal city and port in the Saurashtra region of Gujarat. It is known for ship breaking at Alang (world's largest ship breaking yard) and diamond cutting.
key_facts: Near Alang — world's largest ship breaking yard

locations.name: Umbergaon
locations.description: Umbergaon is a coastal town in Valsad district, located near the Dharampur hills. It is known for its scenic beaches, particularly Tithal beach, and is a popular weekend destination.

locations.name: Pardi
locations.description: Pardi is a town in Valsad district located near Vapi. It serves as a sub-district headquarters and has agricultural and small industrial activities.
key_facts: Close proximity to Vapi industrial zone

locations.name: Chikhli
locations.description: Chikhli is a town in Navsari district, an important agricultural centre. It is known for the production of chikoo (sapodilla) and mango. Has a well-known GIDC industrial estate.
